Per-user settings (Windows Game Mode, advertising, startup “for me”) would apply to that account, and the mouse, keyboard and microphone settings in “Devices & network” will be unavailable. To set up your own profile, sign in to Windows with the administrator account and start Lycoris from there.

en.Видеокарта сама распределяет свою память: The graphics card manages its own memory and work queue instead of Windows. Needed for DLSS frame generation; affects little else.
en.Защита Windows, которая запускает провер: Windows protection that checks drivers inside a separate virtual environment. Raises security; in some games it costs a few percent of FPS.
en.Режим, в котором Windows во время игры н: A mode in which Windows does not install drivers through Windows Update or show restart notifications while you play.
en.Xbox Game Bar и фоновая запись (Game DVR: Xbox Game Bar and background recording (Game DVR)
en.Запись последних минут игры в фоне. Удоб: Records the last minutes of a game in the background. Handy for clips, but always takes resources even when no recording is needed.
en.Набор правил, как быстро процессор повыш: Rules for how fast the processor raises its clock and when it sleeps. «High performance» reacts faster, «Balanced» is quieter and cooler.
en.Память, где Windows держит недавно откры: Memory where Windows keeps recently opened files to open them faster again. It is handed to programs as soon as they need it.
en.Место на диске, куда Windows выгружает р: Space on the drive where Windows moves rarely used data out of memory. Do not turn it off: when memory runs out, programs start closing.
en.Сохранение памяти на диск перед выключен: Saves memory to the drive before shutdown so you can continue where you left off. Takes drive space of roughly part of the RAM size.
en.Команда, которой Windows сообщает SSD, к: The command Windows uses to tell an SSD which blocks are no longer needed. Keeps the SSD's write speed; Windows runs it on schedule by itself.
en.Встроенные средства Windows: DISM чинит: Built-in Windows tools: DISM repairs the component store, SFC restores damaged system files from it. They run one after the other.
en.Окно Windows «Разрешить этому приложению: The Windows prompt «Do you want to allow this app to make changes?». It protects against programs trying to get administrator rights without you knowing. Lycoris does not turn it off.
en.Проверка Windows для скачанных файлов и: A Windows check for downloaded files and websites. It warns about unknown and dangerous programs. Lycoris does not turn it off.
en.Снимок системных файлов и реестра Window: A snapshot of Windows system files and the registry. «System Restore» can take the PC back to that moment; personal files are not touched.
en.Список всего, что меняла Lycoris, с исхо: A list of everything Lycoris changed, with the original values. Any change or a whole batch can be undone on the «Restore» page.
en.Число, которым Диспетчер устройств сообщ: The number Device Manager uses to say why a device does not work: 28 — no driver, 22 — disabled, 32 — the driver service is disabled, and so on.
en.Драйвер, проверенный и подписанный Micro: A driver tested and signed by Microsoft. Such drivers come through Windows Update and official manufacturer sites.
en.Пинг — время ответа сервера в миллисекун: Ping is a server's response time in milliseconds. DNS turns a site name into an address; a slow DNS only delays the first visit to a site.
en.Сколько раз в секунду мышь сообщает своё: How many times a second the mouse reports its position. 1000 Hz means a 1 ms response; more is rarely needed and loads the processor more.
en.Сколько точек курсор проходит за дюйм дв: How many dots the cursor moves per inch of mouse movement. The higher it is, the faster the cursor for the same hand movement.
en.Время, которое драйверы занимают процесс: Time drivers hold the processor outside the normal queue. Long delays cause clicks in sound and stutter in games; usually one specific driver is to blame.
en.Программы, которые Windows запускает при: Programs Windows starts when you sign in. Each one slows sign-in and runs in the background; turning them off is reversible, nothing is uninstalled.
en.Lycoris запущена без прав администратора: Lycoris runs without administrator rights: you can look at and check everything, and an action that needs rights asks for them itself.
